data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 初次朝阳的誓约·「原来阳光……这么烫啊」
data.description: 【想象场景】【地面上·黎明】这是她第一次站在地面上等日出。金色的朝阳越过高山的那一刻，埃列什基伽勒睁大了红瞳，长杖从手里滑落也浑然不觉——「原来阳光……这么烫啊。冥界没有这个……只有冰冷的魂火……呐，明天、明天的日出……也可以一起看吗？」
data.action: 在想象中的首次地面日出时伸手迎光，刚滑落的长兵器躺在脚边岩石上
data.lighting: 金色朝阳铺满全身的强光
data.camera: full-body wide shot, reaching hand and fallen polearm in foreground
data.promptProse: At an imagined first surface sunrise, Ereshkigal opens one hand toward the light over the mountain ridge, awed red eyes overlooking the polearm fallen beside her boots. Her white sweater dress, scarf and beret remain beneath blonde twintails. The horizontal full-body view keeps weapon and rock ledge in the foreground. Golden dawn illuminates her fingers, hair and rock crest, while cooler shadow persists beneath the weapon and across the mountain's opposite slope.
